description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the WorkShiftDao class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods like getWorkShiftById, getWorkShiftList, saveWorkShift, updateWorkShift, deleteWorkShifts, and getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId, verifying database interactions and entity behaviors related to work shifts.

classes.name: WorkShiftDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the WorkShiftDao class, verifying CRUD operations and associated entity behaviors related to work shifts within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, instantiating the WorkShiftDao object and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a work shift by ID and validates the properties of the returned WorkShift entity.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of work shifts using default search parameters and verifies the list contents.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests saving a new WorkShift entity and verifies that the entity's properties are correctly persisted.

methods.name: testEditWorkShift
methods.description: Tests editing an existing WorkShift's properties and verifying the update operation.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified work shifts by IDs and checks the deletion count.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific work shift ID and verifies their details.
